item.description:
The first release of Thimble, a private to-do app for Mac.
- Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday, and Logbook, with projects, areas, headings, tags, checklists, deadlines, repeats, and reminders. - Quick Capture from any app, a menu bar item, the Share menu, and Shortcuts actions. - A lock with Touch ID, daily backups to a folder you choose, and several windows. - English and French.
Your tasks stay on this Mac. The app itself has no network permission; only the update check goes online.
